title: Problem 14-5

pages.text: PROBLEM 14-5 The 1,2 adduct and the 1,4 adduct formed by reaction of HBr with 1,3-butadiene are in equilibrium at 40 °C. Propose a mechanism by which the interconversion of products takes place.
